issues.source_quote: Ваше имя-отчество
issues.translation_quote: your name and patronymic, please?
issues.justification: Acceptable, but the key problem elsewhere: the register of the radio reporter is kept; however the following joke 'Я думал купить жене шубу' is fine. (Minor note only.)

issues.source_quote: Нет, я никуда не еду. Мы провожаем папу!!!
issues.translation_quote: No, I'm not going anywhere. We're seeing Daddy off!
issues.justification: Acceptable; however the preceding 'Но и Вы, тоже едете за границу' lost the comic effect of the reporter's gaffe: the answer is given by a child, not Gorbunkov, which is unmarked.

issues.source_quote: Чёрт возьми! Ух, прости, "Чёрт побери!"
issues.translation_quote: "Damn it!" Oh, sorry—"Blast it!"
issues.justification: The password 'Чёрт побери' is the plot's key phrase and is rendered 'Blast it', which is weaker and loses the devilish oath; Russian 'чёрт' (devil) is an oath the audience recognizes. Also the 'Щёрт побери' foreign-accent mispronunciation is lost, so the joke of foreigners mangling the password disappears.

issues.source_quote: Ой! Ну что же это такое... - Ну разве можно!... Фрис-стрит, рыбна улица, - Аптека «Чиканук»...
issues.translation_quote: Oh! What on earth... - You can't do that! Fris Street, Fish Street, - Chikanuk Pharmacy...
issues.justification: The mother scolding the child and the boy's mispronounced 'рыбна улица' are muddled; the dialogue is confusing and the cue-reading rehearsal (Lyolik drilling the password and address) is not clear.

issues.source_quote: Ну, в общем, с бесчувственного тела; наконец с трупа
issues.translation_quote: Any unconscious body will do. Or even a corpse...
issues.justification: Mistranslation: the colonel lists how they might act (from an insensible body, finally from a corpse); the English turns it into a flippant statement and mangles the escalation that sets up Gorbunkov's 'Whose corpse?' joke.

issues.source_quote: Как говорит наш дорогой шеф, нет такого мужа, который, хоть на час бы не мечтал стать холостяком!
issues.translation_quote: As our dear boss says, there isn't a husband alive who hasn't dreamed of being single for at least an hour!
issues.justification: Fine; but the earlier boss aphorism 'если человек идиот - то это надолго' is rendered 'it's for life', losing the phrase's wry pattern. (Minor loss.)

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike while the iron's hot and don't leave the till!
issues.justification: The deliberately mangled proverb (blending 'куй железо пока горячо' with 'не отходя от кассы') is rendered clumsily; the first occurrence 'куй железо' is acceptable, but the English phrase is awkward and the mixture does not read as a natural boss-ism.

issues.source_quote: Измене!
issues.translation_quote: Treason!
issues.justification: Nadya says 'В измене!' meaning infidelity/adultery (the whole scene is about a suspected mistress); 'Treason' is a mistranslation that changes the meaning, though Nadya also suspects recruitment. Gorbunkov's reply 'мать моих детей' fits infidelity.

issues.source_quote: Эти кретины уверяли, что он был без сознания... Значит, этот лопух ничего не знает.
issues.translation_quote: Those morons swore he was unconscious... So that sucker knows nothing.
issues.justification: 'Лопух' (simpleton) rendered as 'sucker' is acceptable, but elsewhere 'Лопух' becomes 'sucker', 'mark' and 'dummy', creating terminology inconsistency for a recurring character label.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No! I can't go along with that!
issues.justification: The non-standard 'пойтить' marks Lyolik/Gesha's feigned folksy speech; register flattened.

issues.source_quote: Старший экономист в "Гипрорыбе"
issues.translation_quote: Senior economist at Giproryba
issues.justification: Acceptable transliteration, but unexplained for English viewers.

issues.source_quote: Вы в самодеятельности участвуете?
issues.translation_quote: Do you do amateur dramatics?
issues.justification: 'Самодеятельность' is amateur performances broadly, not only drama; slight narrowing.

issues.source_quote: Такова «сё ля ви», как говорят у них...
issues.translation_quote: C'est la vie, as they say over here...
issues.justification: 'У них' means 'over there' (abroad); 'over here' is wrong, and the comic mangled 'такова сё ля ви' is lost.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a stack of tickets today and win yourself a... Waterworks plant!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) is lost; the comic doggerel is rendered as flat prose.

issues.source_quote: Новыми?
issues.translation_quote: In the new notes?
issues.justification: Refers to the 1961 currency reform (new rubles); the cultural joke is not conveyed to the English audience.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: May you drop dead! May I see you in a coffin, in your white funeral slippers! May you live... on nothing but... your salary!
issues.justification: The accented Odessa-style speech and the punchline curse are weakened; the humor of the escalating curses is partially lost.

issues.source_quote: Здравствуйте... - Здравствуйте.
issues.translation_quote: - Hello... - Hello.
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Лёлик, я всё прекрасно помню! Всё должно быть достоверно: Упал, выругался...
issues.translation_quote: Lyolik, I remember everything! It has to look authentic: you fall, you swear...
issues.justification: The speaker is Gesha, but a rehearsal of staged accident is only partly clear; 'Травма' is mistranslated by 'The injury'.

issues.source_quote: Простите, погорячился
issues.translation_quote: Sorry. I lost my temper...
issues.justification: Acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Дальше следует непереводимая игра слов
issues.translation_quote: Here follows an untranslatable play on words involving local idiomatic expressions.
issues.justification: Acceptable fidelity.

issues.source_quote: "Остров Невезения" ... Весь покрытый зеленью, абсолютно весь
issues.translation_quote: Covered all in greenery, green from shore to shore
issues.justification: The nonsense-song humor ('Видно, в понедельник их мама родила' / 'Им бы понедельники взять и отменить') is largely preserved but 'could do away with Mondays' mixes meter and 'On who-knows-what day of who-knows-what year' drops 'никаком году'.

issues.source_quote: Трынь-траву
issues.translation_quote: magic Who-cares grass
issues.justification: The idiom 'трын-трава' (nothing matters) is rendered as invented 'who-cares grass'; workable but 'Who-cares' is also used inconsistently ('who-cares grass' vs 'magic' only).

issues.source_quote: Он сам пришёл!
issues.translation_quote: He came here himself!
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Ксива? Паспорт... готов! Хаза? Отель «Атлантик». Двухкоечный нумер... оплачен!
issues.translation_quote: Papers? Passport... Ready! The place? The Atlantic Hotel. A double room... paid for!
issues.justification: The criminal slang (ксива, хаза) and the hammy gangster voice are flattened into neutral English; character voice is lost.

issues.source_quote: Как говорят у вас там говорят, топай до хазы
issues.translation_quote: As you people say, get your feet home.
issues.justification: 'Топай до хазы' is thieves' slang for 'head to the hideout'; the English 'get your feet home' is nonsensical and the joke at Lyolik's expense is lost.

issues.source_quote: Усё так, как условились.
issues.translation_quote: Just as agreed.
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Пардон... А город пил коктели пряные
issues.translation_quote: And the city drank its spicy cocktails
issues.justification: Okay.

issues.source_quote: Сыграйте... Печёнкой чую, клюнула настоящая рыба.
issues.translation_quote: I can feel it in my bones: we've hooked a real fish.
issues.justification: 'Печёнкой' (in my gut/liver) rendered as 'bones' is a small idiom shift; acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Вы ей ничего не говорите о контрабандистах, золоте, бриллиантах…
issues.translation_quote: Don't tell her about the smugglers, the gold or the diamonds...
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Нью-Йорк-город контрастов
issues.translation_quote: New York: A City of Contrasts
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Козадоев ... Козлодоев... Козладоев
issues.translation_quote: Kozodoyev ... Kozlodoyev ... Kozladoyev
issues.justification: The pun on the name (goat-fucker/козёл) is rendered by near-identical transliterations; the joke is not conveyed to the English viewer.

issues.source_quote: Лёгким движением руки брюки превращаются... в элегантные шорты!
issues.translation_quote: With a flick of the wrist, the trousers become... elegant shorts!
issues.justification: The famous 'брюки превращаются' gag is retained, though the Soviet fashion-show parody voice is neutral.
